_notice: HOME DEMONSTRATION PROTOCOL FOR ISRO BAS HAR. Formulated for practical home-based baseline recording, temporal HAR annotation, and sequence verification. The engine dynamically ingests any JSON protocol definition.
protocol_name: Home Demonstration: 10-Step Object Handling & Container Protocol
description: Standardized home-friendly 10-step protocol designed to evaluate real-time activity recognition, sequence validation, and error detection.

steps.name: IDLE
steps.description: Remain still in the starting position for a few seconds.
steps.voice_prompt_on_complete: Baseline idle confirmed. Step one complete.

steps.name: SANITIZE
steps.description: Pick up hand sanitizer and sanitize the bottle/container.

steps.name: HOLD_BOTTLE
steps.description: Pick up a bottle and hold it clearly for a few seconds.
steps.voice_prompt_on_start: Pick up and hold the bottle.

steps.name: PLACE_BOTTLE
steps.description: Place the bottle back on the table.
steps.voice_prompt_on_start: Place the bottle back on the table.

steps.name: HOLD_BOX
steps.description: Pick up a small box and hold it clearly.
steps.voice_prompt_on_start: Pick up and hold the small box.

steps.name: OPEN_BOX
steps.description: Open the box and briefly inspect it.
steps.voice_prompt_on_start: Open the box and inspect contents.

steps.name: PICK_OBJECT
steps.description: Pick up a small harmless object from the box.
steps.voice_prompt_on_start: Pick up the object from the box.

steps.name: TRANSFER_OBJECT
steps.description: Move the object from the box to another clearly defined location/container.

steps.name: RETURN_OBJECT
steps.description: Pick up the object and return it to the box.
steps.voice_prompt_on_start: Return the object to the box.

steps.name: CLOSE_BOX
steps.description: Close the box and place it back in its original position.
steps.voice_prompt_on_start: Close the box and place it back.
